notes.title: New Update about Fatal Gem VR(The First Match-3 VR Game)
notes.content:
Fatal Gem VR(The First Match-3 VR Game) is really good experience for the Match-3 game and we polished this game according to the players' feedbacks and what is more import that we also adjust the price according to the players' requirements:)

Thanks for loving our game!!! We are indile game studio and please enjoy the special game!!! Thanks!
